note: Eight stages in the order the game lets you play them. Stages 0 and 7 run underneath everything else: start the long counters on day one, and expect the last stage to be the longest.

stages.guidance: GTA VI has no mission replay and no New Game+, so protect the run before it starts: keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission (15 manual slots plus autosave). Never turn cheats on: they disable trophies and saving. The long-haul counters below can all start in the first hour.
stages.name: Before you start — save discipline

stages.guidance: Play Chapter 1, and before its final mission, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot: it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears forever when the chapter ends. It is the only truly missable thing in the game; everything else on this roadmap waits for you.
stages.name: Chapter 1 — Paradise, and the one missable

stages.guidance: Jason and Lucia both become playable in this chapter, which switches on the partner trophies. Daily Driver unlocks the garage market and Moses opens the Scooter Bros app, so buy garages and register vehicles as the money arrives.
stages.name: Chapter 2 — Two of everything

stages.guidance: The strand Race Against Yago appears in this chapter and is time-sensitive: run it the moment it shows. Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun, the key to Sneakthief. Fresh manual save at the chapter start, as always.
stages.name: Chapter 3 — Vice City opens up

stages.guidance: Near the end of Chapter 4, clear the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is' to unlock the bank vaults. From here the money trophies open up: rob vaults, and push marked bills through your laundering contacts.
stages.name: Chapter 4 — Money on the table

stages.guidance: Close out the stranger strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret's hunt. None of them expire: every finale stays available after the credits, so this stage slides to whenever it fits.
stages.name: Strand finales

stages.guidance: Finish the story (manual save before the final mission first), then sweep up what the open world still owes you: drone races, card sets, the VCIA jet, the Mile Zero tanks, gang operations and the odd little moment trophies. The 100% checklist is now visible under Progress > Stats to steer by.
stages.name: After the credits — cleanup

stages.guidance: What is left is arithmetic: 250 stunts (300 for the checklist), 42 range golds, 50 challenges on the way to 70 of 80, and the 100% line itself. When A Long Road pops, the Platinum follows it into your cabinet.
stages.name: The 100% grind

title: Roadmap to the Platinum
